meta.title: Logo exploration for Autoservis Janov
meta.anchor: Local automotive service and repair workshop
meta.summary: Compare restrained automotive logo directions built around a subtle car silhouette, workshop trust, and readable service signage.

preserve: car motif as a first-read identity cue
works on website header, signage, invoices, and social avatar

routes.label: Quiet Workshop Wordmark
routes.prompt: Create a restrained logo exploration tile for Autoservis Janov on a white inspection background. Use a subtle modern car silhouette as a construction line beside a strong readable wordmark. Use deep workshop green, charcoal black, neutral grey, and generous white space. No red accent, no taglines, no fake seals, no partner marks, no racing styling.
routes.rationale: A quiet car line gives the automotive cue without making the identity feel like clip art.
routes.best_for: Website header, garage sign, and printed documents.
routes.decision_advice: Use if the brand should feel direct, trustworthy, and modern without looking like a motorsport brand or generic repair icon.
routes.watch_out: The car line must stay bold enough at favicon or mobile header size.
routes.next_step: Vectorize the silhouette and tune wordmark spacing for small-size use.

routes.label: Service Shield
routes.prompt: Create a logo exploration tile for Autoservis Janov using a compact shield or badge with a simplified car front and workshop-service feel. Keep the typography bold and readable, use deep green and charcoal with restrained red accent. White inspection background. No taglines, no fake certification seal, no partner logos.
routes.rationale: A badge can make the workshop feel established and locally reliable.
routes.best_for: Uniforms, stickers, social avatar, and small branded surfaces.
routes.decision_advice: Use if the business wants a more emblem-like local service identity.
routes.watch_out: Badge detail can become heavy in the website header.
routes.next_step: Simplify the badge into a one-color icon before production.

routes.label: Road And Wrench
routes.prompt: Create a minimal logo exploration tile for Autoservis Janov where a car roof line and road stroke subtly combine with a workshop tool cue such as a wrench gesture. Strong readable wordmark, deep green, charcoal, white background, tiny red accent only if needed. No tagline, no fake seals.
routes.rationale: Combines car and repair without drawing a literal complex vehicle.
routes.best_for: Small digital sizes and utilitarian workshop materials.
routes.decision_advice: Use if the mark needs to stay recognizable in compact places.
routes.watch_out: The tool cue should not overpower the car motif.
routes.next_step: Test the mark at 32px and 64px before finalizing.

routes.label: Janov Motion Wordmark
routes.prompt: Create a logo exploration tile for Autoservis Janov with the car motif integrated as a motion line through or above the wordmark. Use modern service typography, deep green and charcoal, white inspection background, confident but not racing-focused. No tagline, no partner marks.
routes.rationale: Keeps the identity mostly typographic while adding an automotive gesture.
routes.best_for: Website masthead, vehicle decal, and business card.
routes.decision_advice: Use if the name should carry the identity more than a standalone icon.
routes.watch_out: Motion styling can feel generic if the line is too decorative.
routes.next_step: Refine the wordmark in vector and build a compact icon from the line.
